name: idle-compactor
description: Compacts an idle Claude Code session shortly before its 1-hour prompt cache expires, so coming back later re-sends a short summary instead of the whole conversation uncached.

enabled.title: Idle compaction enabled
enabled.description: Compact idle sessions automatically. Turn off to pause without uninstalling.

idle_minutes.title: Compact after (minutes idle)
idle_minutes.description: Minutes after the last response before compacting. Must be under the 60-minute cache lifetime.

cutoff_minutes.title: Give up after (minutes idle)
cutoff_minutes.description: If the check first runs later than this (for example after the Mac slept), skip: the cache is likely gone and compacting would be paid at full price.

min_context_tokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
min_context_tokens.description: Only compact sessions whose context is at least this large. Smaller ones gain little from a summary.

max_per_day.title: Max idle compactions per day
max_per_day.description: Safety cap across all sessions on this machine, per UTC day.
